component.name: Umaet
component.summary: Simple personal finance and budget tracker for KDE Plasma

description.p: Umaet is a native KDE Plasma personal finance tracker built with Qt 6 and Kirigami. It helps you keep track of daily income and expenses, plan monthly budgets, and visualize spending trends across weeks, months, and years.

ul.li: Log income and expenses with customizable categories, dates, and notes.
Comprehensive trend charts aggregated by week, month, and year.
Monthly budgeting with global caps and category-level limits.
Fast local SQLite storage with JSON and CSV bulk import/export.
